_comment: Lessons shown on the Classes tab. Visitors using French see the 'fr' version of each lesson; every other language sees 'en'. A lesson with only one language only shows for that language. Free lessons: put the Google Drive file ID in 'video' (the part between /d/ and /view in the share link; the file must be shared as 'Anyone with the link'). Paid lessons: set 'free' to false, add 'price' and put the Gumroad link in 'url'. Lessons appear in the order listed here.
